project_name: Gemini Data Center SD / Sioux Falls Technology Park data center campus
developer: Gemini Data Center SD, LLC / Gemini Capital
status_detail: City of Sioux Falls Planning Commission staff report for petition SUB-P-022062-2025 identifies Gemini Data Center SD, LLC as owner/applicant, a 164-acre Gemini Addition south of E. Rice St. and east of Veterans Pkwy in Minnehaha County, and states the purpose is future industrial development for a data center; City Council public hearing was scheduled for Jan. 6, 2026. Tracker sources report a 500 MW planned campus, with four 120 MW building listings.
notes: Official source confirms applicant, 164-acre site, location, and data-center use; MW comes from tracker/listing and should be treated as reported rather than permit-confirmed.

project_name: TierPoint Sioux Falls - East Data Center
status_detail: TierPoint lists an operating Sioux Falls East data center at 700 East 54th Street North; it is interconnected with TierPoint's Sioux Falls West and Omaha facilities and marketed as a secure South Dakota colocation/data center facility.
notes: TierPoint page is operator source; quick crawl saw access restrictions but search/indexed text and secondary local telecom article corroborate two Sioux Falls TierPoint facilities. Capacity omitted because operator source does not provide MW in accessible text.

project_name: TierPoint Sioux Falls - West Data Center
status_detail: TierPoint lists an operating Sioux Falls West enterprise data center and colocation facility at 5300 North La Mesa Drive, northwest of Sioux Falls near I-90, with 25,000+ total sq ft and 4,300+ sq ft raised floor space.
notes: Operator page provides address and facility details in indexed text; local SDN article says SDN owns the northwestern Sioux Falls building used by TierPoint.

aliases: Sequitor Edge Tier 3 Edge Computing Facility
Black Hills Industrial Center data center
status_detail: Elevate Rapid City announced on Feb. 11, 2026 that Sequitor Edge will develop a new Tier 3 edge computing center on about 10 acres in Rapid City's Black Hills Industrial Center. Local reporting describes a 30,000 sq ft facility starting at 2 MW and expandable to 10 MW; later KOTA reporting says the planned facility is moving forward and cites 15 MW, with construction not expected until late 2026.
notes: Primary source is EDA announcement. Capacity has conflicting public reports: 2 MW initial/10 MW expandable vs KOTA's later 15 MW; recorded 10 MW as conservative expandable capacity from announcement-era reports.
